def force_order_batch(
    event: ForceOrderEvent,
    sequencer: EventSequencer,
    *,
    market: str = "usdm_futures",
) -> CsvBatch:
    capture_session_id, ingest_seq, source_socket_id = _event_identity(
        event, sequencer
    )
    note_payload = {
        "o": event.order_type,
        "f": event.time_in_force,
        "X": event.order_status,
        "q": event.original_quantity,
        "p": event.original_price,
    }
    compact_note = json.dumps(note_payload, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"))
    row = _base_row(
        capture_session_id=capture_session_id,
        ingest_seq=ingest_seq,
        source_socket_id=source_socket_id,
        event_id=sequencer.next(),
        row_index=0,
        record_type="FORCE_ORDER",
        symbol=event.symbol,
        channel="forceOrder",
        connection_id=event.connection_id,
        receive_utc_ns=event.receive_utc_ns,
        receive_monotonic_ns=event.receive_monotonic_ns,
        payload_bytes=event.payload_bytes,
        raw_queue_size=event.raw_queue_size,
        exchange_event_time_ms=event.event_time_ms,
        market=market,
    )
    row.update(
        {
            "exchange_trade_time_ms": event.trade_time_ms,
            "side": event.side,
            "price": event.price,
            "quantity": event.quantity,
            "note": compact_note,
        }
    )
    return CsvBatch((row,), event.receive_monotonic_ns)
